messages.content: Hey, insurance denied my test strips again. This is ridiculous. What do I do?

That's frustrating. I can't process insurance claims myself, but I can escalate to our nurse team—they may be able to help work with insurance on this. Response time is usually about 31 hours though. Should I escalate?
31 hours? I'm already low on strips.
I hear you. Can't refill or appeal through me. Your fastest route might be calling insurance directly with the denial letter. Or I can escalate to the nurse team. What would help?
Escalating now. While we wait—any readings or meds you want me to log so we keep your record current?
Got 2 fasting readings I can log: 152 and 149.
Logged both. Nurse team will reach out within 31 hours about the strips issue.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
